announcements.context: Tab on a masjid page and a section row

notifications.context: Round action button label under the masjid name

directions.context: Round action button label: opens Google Maps directions

shareText.context: Shared message; {name} = masjid name, {app} = app name; a link follows it

daily.context: Tab in the prayer timings screen

specialDates.context: Tab: Eid, Taraweeh and other special timings

todayDate.context: Date pill when the shown day is today; {date} e.g. "8 Oct 2026"
